content: Amfum ban'dirà Yɛsu
Mpal kàmay Yɛsu nswɛɛŋ ayi yanswà, nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:
« Bɛ làkyàyöb naa un'kyɔm a Pak ayàkal ungö a ilä byeel: Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà, ntɔn bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi. »
Apan, andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ a Ayudà bakyer aköŋ u ndwà a Undweer a angaŋ Kayifa.
Ba bàtsül mukɔr Yɛsu u mbwo a loor anà mukun'dwa.
Wɛɛ, ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Wɛy ya ikɔɔn akal umpal bàkyɔɔmà ba, manà lingyoomà làyàbwà uboo a un'sɛŋ. »
Un'kaar mwɛy anà may a usɔŋ
Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtani u ndwà a Simɔn ŋabay.
Un'kaar mwɛy kàyàsin apà nde anà un'laŋ wàŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ bàfàbel naa albatre. Ma mà ntal mbɔɔn. Nde kàtyaŋ ma udu a un'tswe a Yɛsu mpal kàkäl nde mudyà.
Mpal bàmɛn alɔŋki abun, ba bàmɛn ube mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛn naa: « Ntɔn nkye ubii a tub abà?
Yàlàbwaŋ muyälà may a usɔŋ amà u ntal a mbɔɔn, waa ngim ayin bàlàpà aŋàlàmbwà! »
Mpal kàyöb Yɛsu an'kyän aba, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye làpà bɛ un'kaar wà mpay? Nde kan'kyer ndaa aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mɛ.
Ntɔn aŋàlàmbwà bà anà bɛ ilä byanswà, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'wà anki anà bɛ ilä byanswà.
Kan'tyaŋ nde may a usɔŋ mà udu a ndür amɛ, nde kan'lɔɔn ndyee amɛ.
Ndandaa mɛ alakyään: mper yanswà bàsàkàkyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, u mɛɛn manswà, bàsakyäänà sye ndaa kan'kyer un'kaar wà, ntɔn mukun'yɔbà. »
Yudasi akwen muyälà Yɛsu
Apan, Yudasi Isikalyɔt, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki kwem aŋiyweel bà Yɛsu, kàkàman andweer a angaŋ,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ininà bɛ lan'pà, waa mɛ alàpà awà? » Ba bun'pɛ itɛr a ngim an'kwem an'tär.
Sɛmà apan, Yudasi kàyileŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mukapɛɛl awà.
Yɛsu kan'dyà Pak
Ilä a tàtwɛb kyà un'kyɔm a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, alɔŋki bàyi akà Yɛsu mukun'fuul naa: « Ngye akwen naa bi ikàlɔn ken ikal adyà ngye Pak? »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen u bul a kölàköl, akà mbuur mwɛy, lun'kyään naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ an'tɛn naa: Taaŋ amɛ là tsütsü, mɛ anà alɔŋki amɛ in'yàdyà Pak u ndwà angye." »
Alɔŋki bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Pak asànaa kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kan'dyà Pak anà alɔŋki ande
Mpal a sisye, Yɛsu kàkäl u mɛsà anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Mpal bàkäl ba mudyà, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: umwɛy uboo a bɛ ayan'mɛɛn nku. »
Ba bàmɛn ngyɛb mbɔɔn, waa bàsɛmà mukun'fuul umwɛy umwɛy naa: « Mwol, nkye mɛ? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mbuur awà kan'biil kɔɔ mbwo mwɛy anà mɛ uboo a làlɔŋà a isaa, mbuur nsil awà ayan'mɛɛn nku.
Mwan a mbuur wàmukyà asànaa Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikyäänà ya ntɔn nde. Wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur amɛɛn Mwan a mbuur nku! Yàlàkal ubwaŋ naa mbuur awà bàkɔɔn a un'bɔr! »
Yudasi, mbuur ayun'yälà, kun'fuul naa: « Mwol, nkye mɛ? » Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn. »
Isaa un'kyɛɛl
Umpal bàkäl ba mudyà, Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà, ungö kàsaak nde ma, nde kàtsül ma, kàpɛ alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mää, làdi, ayi yà ndür amɛ. »
Ungö, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb a vin, ungö mufuur an'tɔɔn, nde kàpɛ ba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Lànü la bɛ banswà,
ntɔn mamà an'kil amɛ, an'kil a un'tüüb, màpää ntɔn un'kàbɔ a baar, ntɔn ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: sɛmà apanà, mɛ in'fàsànwà anki vin tii ilä in'sànwà mɛ vin akün mbwo mwɛy anà bɛ uboo a Imwol a Taaràmɛ. »
Ungö mutɔl an'diim a un'kyɔm, ba bàtoo ntɔn mukyà mɔŋ a In'te a ɔlive.
Petɔlà kan'tɔn Yɛsu
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « U mpib a ŋàbà, bɛ banswà làkyer abwà ntɔn mɛ. Ntɔn bàsön naa: "Mɛ, mɛ in'sàdwa un'kyɛɛŋ a in'kɔk, waa in'kɔk a làböl myàsàtà upay."
Wɛɛ, mpal in'sàwiyà mɛ, mɛ in'sàlafweel u Ngalilɛ. »
Petɔlà kàwɛl ndaa, waa kàtɛn naa: « Itàkal naa ba banswà ban'bwà ntɔn ngye, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'sàbwà anki akà ikikye. »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ, ndandaa mɛ akyään: u mpib nsil ayi, kusà a nkɔɔ mutàbeel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär. »
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Itàkal naa mɛ in'kyer akwà anà ngye, aay, mɛ in'satɔn anki. » Waa alɔŋki banswà bàtɛn sye mun mwɛy wa.
Yɛsu an'kyà Ngɛtɛsɛmani
Yɛsu kàyàkɔlà anà alɔŋki ande kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel Ngɛtɛsɛmani, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Sàlàbwaayà pà, mpal in'kàyamà mɛ kunà. »
Ungö apan nde kàsyen Petɔlà anà baan a Zebeday babaal bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa kàsɛmà muman ngyɛb anà bɔɔmà aŋàdiir.
Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mpem amɛ yàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb mbɔɔn tsütsü a ukwà. Sàlakälà pà anà làgyɛɛŋ anà mɛ. »
Nde kàkyen u kikwɛl, waa kàbü, ntabwey u mɛɛn, waa kàyamà abà: « Taa, kya mbwo isàkal, wɛy kɔɔb là làlyaŋ ukwɛl apà mɛ! Itàkal naa abwɛy, kyer ukwen angye, wɛɛ kà bàmɛ anki. »
Nde kan'yà ntsü bàkäl alɔŋki ande batär, waa kàmaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. Nde kan'tɛn a Petɔlà naa: « Abà, nkye bɛ làkal anki anà ngwal mukyɛɛŋ itàkal taaŋ làmwɛy anà mɛ!
Làkyɛɛŋ anà làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. Dweelà làŋàyɔl a ngwal, wɛɛ ndür ye anà ukwarà. »
U mbalà yàyweel, nde kàkyà ukwel, waa kàyamà abà: « Taaràmɛ, isàkal naa ikwe anki naa kɔɔb làlyaŋ, naa mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n anwà la, wɛy ukwen angye bàkäl! »
U mbalà asin kàfàyà nde apà alɔŋki ande, nde kàfaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn mii aba myàkäl myàŋàbwà buur.
Yɛsu waa kàsawɛy, waa kàkyen ukwɛl, waa kàyamà mbalà yàtär, wàmufuur ndaa nsil ya.
Apan, kàyi nde apà alɔŋki, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Fàlabɔ̈ɔ̈nà, fàlàyöörà! Kyekà taaŋ bàyälà ba Mwan a mbuur kà an'kɔɔ a baar abe lye tsütsü.
Làmbarà! Tsweenà! Le mbuur kàman'yälà wà tsütsü! »
Nköör a Yɛsu
Umpal kàkäl nde muyäämà, Yudasi, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel kàyàkɔlà anà iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàtöm andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ. Ba bàkäl anà an'kɔm anà nköl.
Mbuur kun'yälà, kapɛ idiim ki: « Mbuur wanswà in'kàböbà mɛ, mbuur wa nde awun. Lun'kör. »
Taaŋ nsil alan, Yudasi kàsin apà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, mbɔr angye! » Waa kun'böbà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'sam, kyer undiir ayeel ngye. » Apan, laa bàsin ba, bun'tɛ ba mpi, waa bun'kör.
Umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl a Yɛsu, kàsilà kɔɔ, waa kàtwey kɔm ande, laa kàkäm nde un'syääl a undweer a angaŋ, waa kun'tsül tsü.
Apan, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Fuur kɔm angye kà ikal a la, ntɔn baar banswà bàfàsyääl kɔm, bàsàkwà a kɔm.
Nkye ngye ayöb anki naa mɛ an'kwo in'lɔ̈ɔ̈m akà Taaràmɛ, nde sye kan'tööm in'lwaaŋ kwem aŋiyweel myà akyeey làgyägyä?
Ndaa Aŋàsön ayà itɛɛnà naa ya ikal abà, yàlàkwo aben? »

Utaaŋ alan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a iköŋ a baar naa: « Bɛ, bɛ lan'yà anà an'kɔm anà nköl ntɔn muyan'kɔr asànaa mɛ iwà un'dwää baar! Ilä byanswà mɛ kàkäl aŋàbwaay u ndwà a Nzam mulɔŋ, wɛɛ bɛ lan'nkör anki.
Wɛɛ ayi yanswà yan'yà ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn a aŋangɔɔm ikwe. » Apan, alɔŋki banswà bàkyer asun'kɔɔb, waa bàtiin.
Yɛsu kusà a làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl
Baar abà bàkör Yɛsu bun'syen akà undweer a angaŋ Kayifa, ikal bàköŋ alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn anà andweer.
Petɔlà kàyun'labà ukwɛl tii u làpaŋ a undweer a angaŋ. Nde kàbilà u làpaŋ, waa kàbwaay ikal imwɛy anà aseey ntɔn muler naa ya ikàtsü aben.
Amfum a angaŋ anà Làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl lanswà bàleŋà imbäl a loor ntɔn Yɛsu ntɔn bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà.
Itàkal naa ambäl a loor mbɔɔn bàkyer ayàmɛnà, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki akà imbäl mwɛy. Ungöngö, abɔ̈ɔ̈l waa bàyàmɛnà,
waa bàtɛn naa: « Mbuur wà kàtɛn naa: "Mɛ an'kwo in'bwaab ndwà a Nzam, waa in'fàtɔŋ ya ungö a ilä itär." »
Undweer a angaŋ laa kàmbarà nde, waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Nkye ngye undiir afuur anki unsà ya yanswà bafüünà baar bà? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkälà a duu. Waa undweer a angaŋ kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ amaswaŋ kà ikɔb a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈, tɛn a bi, isàkal naa ngye, ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ngye an'tɛn ya. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa semà apanà, bɛ làsàman Mwan a mbuur akyàbwaay u kɔɔ a ibaal a Ngwal anà wàmuyà udu a an'töb a du. »
Apan, undweer a angaŋ kàkaam ipfɛy ande, waa kàtɛn naa: « Nde wàmubɛy! Bi ambäl nkye ifàkyer abà! Apanà bɛ lan'wem mbɛɛy ande!
An'kyän abɛ mà aben? » Ba bàfuur naa: « Nde akyà ukwà. »
Apan ba bun'tsül an'te u ntabwey, bun'düb iki, bumwɛy bun'käm an'füm.
Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ɛɛ, Klistɔ, bulà ŋangɔɔm ntɔn bi! Ikyään, nà kàmakam mbar? »
Petɔlà kan'tɔn Yɛsu
Kyekà Petɔlà kàkäl aŋàbwaay u nsà, uboo a làpaŋ. Un'syääl mwɛy wun'kaar kàsin apà nde, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye sye, ngye kàkäl anà Yɛsu, un'nsi Ngalilɛ. »
Wɛɛ nde kàtön u mii a baar banswà, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye ininà atɛɛnà. »
Nde kàkäl mukyà mper akà munàmbwo a làpaŋ, mpal kun'mɛn un'syääl asin wun'kaar anà kàtɛn nde a baar bàkäl paa: « Mbuur wà kàkäl a Yɛsu un'nazɔrya. »
Nde kàfàtɔn mbalà asin, waa kàdi kyän naa: « Mɛ, mɛ mbuur awà un'yöb anki. »
Ungö ikye, baar bàkäl paa bàsin apà Petɔlà, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ndandaa, ngye sye awà umwɛy uboo a baar banà, ntɔn ntɛɛn angye ikaswaŋà ubwaŋàbwaŋ. »
Apan, nde kàsɛmà mudyà kyän anà muŋan naa: « Mɛ, mɛ un'yöb anki mbuur awà! » Apan sye nkɔɔ mwɛy waa kàbel.
Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kàtɛn Yɛsu naa: « Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär. » Laa kàtoo nde, waa kàlel a un'kwoon wanswà.
